title: Lookonchain claims Ansem's wallet was hacked and USDC moved; unconfirmed
date_note: Both articles are dated 24 November and give no earlier day.
summary: On-chain analytics firm Lookonchain said in an X post that Ansem's wallet appears to have been hacked, according to Bloomingbit and PANews. PANews says 215 万枚 USDC has so far been transferred to a wallet on Arbitrum. Bloomingbit says the scope of the hack and total damage are unconfirmed; neither article reports confirmation from Ansem.
plain: Analytics firm Lookonchain says a crypto wallet linked to Ansem appears to have been hacked, with USDC moved to another wallet. Nobody has confirmed it.
exec: An unconfirmed on-chain claim says USDC left Ansem's wallet; no confirmation from Ansem was reported.

sources.name: PANews: Ansem 钱包疑遭黑客攻击，约 215 万 USDC 被转移
Bloomingbit: 룩온체인 ANSEM 관련 지갑 해킹 정황

evidence.quote: 目前已转移 215 万枚 USDC

validation.note: PANews and Bloomingbit both relay one Lookonchain X post; neither reports a statement from Ansem. The X post itself was not read.

review.note: summary: added 'so far' per PANews; claim status and severity 1 match both articles
